conviction_note: Near-non-result: no profit warning, no pre-release, no numeric guidance to change, and the Q3 adjusted-EBITA bar is split between DNB Carnegie at SEK 143m and Analysguiden at 157m, while the H1 margin trend (+0.3 to +0.8pp y/y on about SEK 2,975m of sales) points to 143-158m, which is inside that range. findings.finding: WISAG Service Holding Europa (Michael Wisser) holds 28,743,506 Coor shares = 29.9999% of capital and votes since 2026-07-30, parked one share-fraction below Sweden's 30% mandatory-bid threshold. It chairs the nomination committee (2026-09-30), deferred the dividend vote at the April AGM and voted down the buyback and issuance authorisations. Free float is about 70%, and a weak print makes a bid cheaper for the holder that is already at the line.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None observed: the flaggings of June to August came with the stock drifting from about 51 to 49.6, so the bid optionality has not been priced as a premium so far
findings.original_quote: Efter transaktionen: Antal - aktier 28 743 506 ... Andel - aktier 29,9999 % ... Kedja av kontrollerande företag ... WISAG Service Holding Europa GmbH (After the transaction: 28,743,506 shares, 29.9999% of shares, held through WISAG Service Holding Europa GmbH)
findings.why_not_priced: Public since August, so the level is known. What is not priced is the asymmetry it creates on a downside print: if the market had treated WISAG as a floor, the stock would carry a visible premium after the August flagging, and it has instead drifted down 1.9% over 20 days. Small, because it is an inference about the reaction function and not a company number, and no offer period exists.

findings.finding: The Q3 2026 report will carry an estimated SEK 20-25m item affecting comparability for a lost Danish arbitration from 2022, which depresses reported EBIT and EPS (about SEK 0.2/share pre-tax on 95.8m shares) while sitting outside adjusted EBITA.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025: reported EPS SEK 0.5 against a Yahoo estimate of 0.668 and the stock fell 6.6% on the day, but that print also missed on the underlying line. There is no clean history of a pre-announced IAC alone moving the stock
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced: pre-announced in July and named in Analysguiden's preview. The residual is headline risk on a thin name, where a reported-EPS miss against an adjusted Yahoo bar can print badly in the first minutes. If fully priced, nothing would move on it. Sized at a fraction because it is a pre-announced one-off below operating income with no path to the guide.
findings.independence: Analysguiden preview, 2026-10-15: 'påverkat av höga jämförelsestörande poster varav 20-25 mkr avser en skiljedom för ett äldre kundärende i Danmark' (affected by high items affecting comparability, of which SEK 20-25m relates to an arbitration over an old customer case in Denmark), https://www.aktiespararna.se/analyser/infor-rapporten-coor-en-brytpunkt-narmar-sig
